messages:
daria (People Ops): Hi folks 30ncoming All-Hands follow-up thread about hybrid/office ops, per q's today. I'll consolidate answers here. Topics: local commute reimbursements, desk bookings at satellites, childcare travel stipends, and whether any teams should block off days for upcoming roadmaps.

raj (Eng): Quick one 4 for reimbursements: if I take an Uber from the airport to a satellite office, what receipts do you need? Can I submit a monthly batch or must it be per-trip?

eileen (HR): You can batch monthly but each expense line needs a receipt image and trip date. Best practice: upload same day if possible. Use "Travel:Local" category in Expensify and mark destination as the office city.

travel-bot: Reminder: New policy v2.1 requires city code on expenses for audit. See https://redwood.internal/policies/travel-v2.1

omar (Facilities): For satellite parking: most hubs have limited guest parking. If you're driving, request a parking pass at least 72 hours in advance via the facilities form. We can sometimes arrange a curbside drop if you have heavy equipment.

zoe (Product): Childcare stipend question from the All-Hands  any chance for a one-time stipend for parents traveling to offsites?

daria (People Ops): We're piloting a small childcare travel stipend for product offsite attendees: $200 per family, reimbursable with proof of childcare payment (invoice/receipt). Pilot limited to company-funded offsites only and requires manager approval.

marta (Legal): Note: receipts must not include sensitive personal info. For international teammates, follow data transfer guidance when uploading documents. If you have questions, DM Legal.

raj (Eng): Booking desks at the Seattle satellite  is it still first-come within 5 days? I remember there was talk of a fairness cap.

omar (Facilities): Updated rule: desk booking opens 5 days prior; users can hold up to 4 days within any 21-day window. We also reserve 10% of desks as "hot-desks" for same-day drop-ins. If your team needs a block of desks for a weekly collab, submit the team-block request form; we review for capacity and equity.

zoe (Product): If Product wants a recurring Tuesday collab in SF HQ for 6 people, what's the best workflow?

daria (People Ops): Submit a "recurring-space" request and cc your manager. We require 2-week lead time for recurring requests. If approved, Facilities will provision a recurring block and we'll reserve a small buffer for last-minute additions.

raj (Eng): Any updates on travel caps? The All-Hands slide mentioned more flexibility for mission-critical in-person work.

eileen (HR): Travel caps remain the baseline: $100/day for local ground travel, $350 one-way for domestic flights without pre-approval. Managers can grant exceptions for project-critical travel; submit an expense pre-approval note with rationale.

travel-bot: Note: Pre-approval requests without manager sign-off will be auto-denied after 48hrs.

marta (Legal): Also flagging visa/entry requirements for international offsites  if any teammates need letters of invitation or company support, submit at least 6 weeks before travel so Legal can assist.

omar (Facilities): For the Q3 team summit (tentative): we're exploring on-site childcare options and a subsidized shuttle from the airport. No firm date yet; prefer July/Aug window. Facilities Ops will post a planning doc soon.

daria (People Ops): Actions: 1) People Ops FAQ update with parking, receipts, and stipend details; 2) Facilities will publish booking limits and recurring request form link; 3) Finance/HR will add example expense categories to the travel wiki. Will ping channels when published.

raj (Eng): Etiquette q: if my team has mixed presence, should we default to async and only schedule 1-2 in-person days per sprint?

eileen (HR): Recommended pattern: teams define a "team-day" cadence each sprint and communicate 72 hours in advance. For cross-team workshops, aim for a minimum 2 weeks' notice.

zoe (Product): +1. Also request a shared "collab calendar" label so other teams can see booked collab weeks.

daria (People Ops): Good idea  I'll ask EngOps to add a label filter for collab events.

marta (Legal): One more legal note: if you plan to record sessions during offsites, include a recording notice in the event invite and get consent for external attendees.

raj (Eng): Thanks everyone  super helpful.

daria (People Ops): Thanks team  I'll close this thread after I post the FAQ and links. If you have special cases (accessibility, visa, childcare beyond pilot), DM me or fill the relevant form. :party-popper:
